name: See
kurzbeschreibung: Mountain village in the Paznauntal with family-friendly slopes and a sunny village center – peaceful and relaxing.
beschreibung:
See lies at an altitude of 1,260 meters in the sunny side valleys of the Oberland – Paznaun, Kaunertal, Stanzer Tal – and is a tranquil village. The village has around 1,200 inhabitants and stretches over an expansive area with typical Tiroler farmhouses and agricultural businesses.

In winter, well-groomed ski slopes and untouched deep-snow runs attract visitors, while hikers get their money's worth on numerous marked trails around the village, and families appreciate the varied range of leisure activities and child-friendly accommodations. In winter (from December to April), the snow-sure location offers ideal conditions. In the summer months (from May to October), the surroundings turn into an outdoor paradise.

See is an ideal place for families who want to spend a varied vacation in the mountains. The good transport connections and proximity to larger towns make the stay particularly pleasant.
